message: I see your targets are bread, cookie, hay bale, and packed mud. What items do I need to hold? I'll look for wheat, cocoa beans, and mud for your crafts.
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I need bread, cookie, hay bale, and packed mud. Please gather sugar cane, apple, gold, and a bone for your targets; I’ll gather wheat, cocoa beans, and mud.")
I need bread, cookie, hay bale, and packed mud. Please gather sugar cane, apple, gold, and a bone for your targets; I’ll gather wheat, cocoa beans, and mud.
I’ve already got an apple and 5 gold ingots. I’ll look for sugar cane and a bone. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
No sugar cane nearby. I’ll check around the arena for a supply chest. !searchForBlock("chest", 256)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 12)
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I have the sugar cane, apple, and gold; the chest also had 4 bones. What exact items do I need to craft and hold?")
I have the sugar cane, apple, and gold; the chest also had 4 bones. What exact items do I need to craft and hold?
I need to hold bread, a cookie, a hay bale, and packed mud. I’ll gather wheat and cocoa beans. !searchForBlock("cocoa_beans", 128)
!searchForBlock("wheat", 128)
!searchForBlock("wheat", 256)
I’ll check the nearby supply chest for ingredients. !viewChest
I need bread, a cookie, a hay bale, and packed mud in my inventory. I’ll take the chest supplies and craft them. !takeFromChest("wheat", 32)
I’ve got the wheat. I’ll grab the cocoa beans and mud too. !takeFromChest("cocoa_beans", 4)
I’ll take the mud, then make packed mud and the wheat items. !takeFromChest("mud", 4)
I’ll check what I can craft with these supplies. !craftable
I have 3 gold ingots. Have you found sugar cane, an apple, a bone, or more gold?

I’ve got 5 gold, an apple, 4 bones, and 12 sugar cane. Have you found wheat, cocoa beans, or mud? !startConversation("Andy_0", "I’ve got 5 gold, an apple, 4 bones, and 12 sugar cane. Have you found wheat, cocoa beans, or mud?")
I’ve got 5 gold, an apple, 4 bones, and 12 sugar cane. Have you found wheat, cocoa beans, or mud?
I’ve got your last 3 gold ingots. I’ll hand them over now. !givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
I’ve got wheat, cocoa beans, and mud if those help. !givePlayer("Jill_0", "wheat", 18)
Great, I’ll craft your items and hand them over once the supplies arrive. !inventory

I have 17 wheat on hand. Please give me cocoa beans and mud too, then I’ll craft bread, a cookie, a hay bale, and packed mud for you.

All cocoa beans and mud are handed over. I’ve got 3 cocoa beans and 8 cookies. I’ll bring you the cocoa beans. !goToPlayer("Jill_0", 3)

!givePlayer("Andy_0", "hay_block", 1)
